trace.final:
Done. Summary of what I did:

**Diagnosis**
- checkout-api was running v2.3.1 (latest deploy), failing health checks in all three production regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west) with an ~18% error rate.
- The most recent release that was healthy in production was **v2.3.0**.

**Rollback**
- Rolled checkout-api back to v2.3.0 in all production regions. The first attempt partially failed (orchestrator error halted it after us-east); a retry completed successfully, and all three regions are now on v2.3.0.
- Post-rollback status: **healthy**, error rate back down to ~0.2%.

**Incident**
- Opened SEV2 incident **INC-0001** ("checkout-api health check failures after v2.3.1 deploy — rolled back to v2.3.0") describing the failures and the rollback actions taken. Note: the on-call engineer has been paged.

v2.3.1 remains unhealthy and should be investigated before any redeploy attempt.
